description: ISO 27001 aligned. Simplified, sanitized representation of an Intune Endpoint security > Attack surface reduction policy (not a direct Graph export).
rolloutApproach: Start in Audit mode, review the Defender for Endpoint reports, then move the rules to Block.

attackSurfaceReductionRules.ruleName: Block Win32 API calls from Office macros
Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem (lsass.exe)
Block executable content from email client and webmail
Block untrusted and unsigned processes that run from USB
